name: Kayla Mantle
occupation: Platte County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Kayla Mantle is a Platte County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Ian Jolovich, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election summary lists her with 2,227 votes, alongside re-elected commissioner Steve Shockley.
